verdict.rationale: Klaviyo ships built-in AI agents (Composer, Customer Agent), so letting users connect external MCP servers to those agents is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence only documents Klaviyo's own MCP server, which external clients like Claude or Cursor connect to. That is the server role, not the client role this story asks about. Nothing in the pack shows users plugging third-party MCP servers into Klaviyo or its AI features.
